name: UC200 Pro
description: A powerful, reliable IP PBX for SMEs, supporting up to 500 SIP users and 50 concurrent calls.
overview: UC200 Pro is a powerful and reliable IP PBX designed to meet the communication needs of SMEs, with up to 500 SIP users and 50 concurrent calls. Its versatile features support seamless communication and enhanced productivity while helping reduce phone bills.

The UC200 Pro supports 60, 200, or 500 SIP extensions and 15, 30, or 50 concurrent calls. It includes 2 FXS and 2 FXO ports, supports up to 8 FXS and 8 FXO ports, and has three additional user-board slots for 2S, 2O, or 1S1O modules. Software licenses can increase SIP users and concurrent calls.

Built-in security includes Fail2ban, allow and block lists, ACLs, an IP firewall, TLS, SRTP, and ZRTP. The system supports integration with hotel PMS, billing, CRM, conference, paging, and security systems, and provides an intuitive web interface, remote management, configuration backup and restore, and IP phone auto-provisioning.
Dinstar VoIP gateways support a gradual transition from analog telephony, allowing existing analog phones, fax machines, legacy PBXs, and PSTN lines to be used during migration.
highlights: Up to 500 SIP users and 50 concurrent calls
2 FXO and 2 FXS ports; expandable with up to 3 additional modules
No annual licensing fees or recurring fees
features: Multi-level IVR, auto-attendant, call queue, ring group, and paging
Call forwarding, waiting, holding, transfer, pickup, and parking
Voicemail, voicemail to email, local recording, and call detail records
Flexible routing by time period, caller or called prefix, and source trunk
Failover routing, dial rules, and caller/called number manipulation
T.30/T.38 fax support, conferences, video calls, and intercom
Fail2ban, allow and block lists, ACLs, TLS, SRTP, and ZRTP

name: UC350/UC350 Pro
description: A modular, high-capacity IP PBX series for medium and large enterprises, with up to 5,000 extensions and 500 concurrent calls.
overview: The UC350 Series is a high-capacity unified communications solution. UC350 and UC350 Pro support up to 1,000 and 5,000 extensions, and 100 and 500 concurrent calls, respectively.

Voice, video, paging, fax, conferencing, and recording are integrated in the system. Four hot-pluggable slots accept E1/T1, FXS, and FXO boards so the system can be configured for different deployment needs, including branches of large groups and government agencies.
highlights: UC350: up to 1,000 extensions and 100 concurrent calls
UC350 Pro: up to 5,000 extensions and 500 concurrent calls
Four hot-pluggable slots for E1/T1, FXS, and FXO boards
Voice, video, paging, fax, conference, and recording

name: UC8000
description: A full-featured software edition IP PBX deployable on-premises, in a virtual machine, or in the cloud.
overview: UC8000 is Dinstar's software edition IP PBX. It can run on customer hardware, a virtual machine, or in the cloud and interoperates with Dinstar IP phones and VoIP gateways.
The platform provides an IP telephony solution for medium and large enterprises, single-site and multi-branch organizations, government, and industry deployments.
highlights: Software edition with flexible deployment options
Works with Dinstar IP phones and VoIP gateways
